1. The opening and closing balances in respect of overseas related party transactions (as reflected in this utility) have been converted into INR using the closing conversion rate on March 31, 2026 and September 30, 2026 respectively. 2. Airtel Payments Bank Limited (‘APBL’) is a subsidiary company as per the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013. However, under the applicable Indian Accounting Standards (‘Ind AS’), it is classified as an associate company. The relationship with APBL in the above statement is taken as per Ind AS i.e., associate company.

3. To ensure completeness in reporting,the figures have been rounded up to Two decimels.

4. AMPIN Evolution Private Limited (formerly known as Ampsolar Evolution Private Limited), AMPIN Energy Green Three Private Limited, AMPIN Energy C&I Seventeen Private Limited, AMPIN Energy C&I Sixteen Private Limited, and AMPIN Energy C&I Thirty Private Limited are classified as associate companies under the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013.
